scope: Active NHL, MLB, NFL and NBA input pipelines, caches, time boundaries, workflow execution order and published history dates. No season-wide performance attribution.

NHL.status: confirmed live defect; fixed in this branch
NHL.problem: The archived 07:06 Eastern run had all four October 9 final games but excluded them until reconstructed noon UTC availability. A twelve-hour cache could also cross the Eastern date boundary.
NHL.fix: Use actual observation when earlier than the assumed cutoff; check final reports on every board refresh; preserve historical artifacts and chronological backtests; apply the same completed-date boundary to team, skater and goalie inputs.

MLB.status: same-date model-cache defect reproduced and fixed
MLB.problem: The model cache keyed on code and requested cutoff, so a final first seen on a second same-day refresh could be missing from rolling model history.
MLB.fix: Compare actual observation SHA-256 before reusing the bundle.
MLB.today_interpretation: October 8 is the correct latest completed-game date because October 9 had no games. Final game eligibility, Eastern cutoff and missing-box-score failure guards already exist.

NFL.status: no equivalent fixed-hour cutoff found; weekly boundary retained
NFL.behavior: Current-season player and play-by-play data are downloaded each refresh. Models use weeks strictly earlier than the selected forecast week. Prior-week presence is required. Current-week Thursday games are excluded from Sunday estimates by the weekly boundary.
NFL.limit: Presence of the prior week is not a per-game or per-player completeness proof. No full league-source coverage audit was performed.

NBA.behavior: Workflows attempt current-season regular-season game logs before updating markets. NBA baseline code has no next-day 8 a.m. gate. Failed source retrieval may retain older historical references. The audited snapshot has no player-history rows.
NBA.limit: Current NBA prediction readiness is not established; odds freshness does not establish statistics freshness.
